programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Dino Detective Meekah is on the case! She's on the hunt with her trusty magnifying glass. She enjoys some sensory play, then finds a dino bone and a triceratops puzzle. When she completes the puzzle, she finds Big John, the world's largest triceratops! Then, it's Meekah's toy dino Max's twin sister Patty's birthday, but she's missing! Meekah explores Dino's Alive, seeing cool big dinos and searching for the birthday girl!

programme.title: Blippi

Then he teams up with NBA player Andre Drummond, where they agree to trade skills-Andre teaches Blippi basketball and Blippi teaches Andre how to be more like Blippi!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi and Meekah embark on a rhyming and musical adventure at Rockwood Music Hall! They explore rhythm by playing various instruments like drums and tambourines, creating their own music. Their journey culminates with meeting musical guest Sonia De Los Santos who teaches them how to write a song and invites them to perform with her on stage!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a fun day at the dinosaur park! Park Rangers LB and Aaron embark on an exciting adventure when a paddock fence collapses. They must quickly work together to repair it to prevent the giant dinosaurs from escaping! Then, the two rangers visit Dinosaur World to check out the massive life-size dinosaurs. Later, they have a fun hide-and-seek challenge among the dinos, competing for a mystery prize. Who will win the thrilling game?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: It's time to meet the new Park Rangers at T-Rex Ranch! First, a new park ranger, Zoey, joins the team and encounters a mysterious time-rewinding gadget on her first dinosaur mission. The gadget creates all sorts of problems as she tries to navigate the chaos it causes. Then, it's time to meet Cam, the newest member of the park ranger team! On his first mission, he joins Zoey on an adventure to track down the elusive Peteinosaurus dinosaur.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready for an epic search and rescue adventure with the Park Rangers! First, Park Ranger Zoey accidentally zaps Park Ranger Maddison into the dinosaur wild zone! She will have to use all her park ranger wit to get out safely. Then, Park Ranger Darren goes off to feed the baby Brachiosaurus, but on his mission, he accidentally loses it! Can the park ranger team work together to find the lost baby dino?

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a tough day! It's Jeff's birthday, and everyone is in party mode except Jeff. His strict rules and regulations threaten to derail his own celebrations! Finally, after a mishap on a hot air balloon trip, Pogo and Jeff find themselves stranded on a desert island!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a strange night for the Oddbods! Slick fancies himself a great dancer, but he's terrible! When he discovers the truth, Jeff is kind enough to offer his services and soon transforms him into quite the mover. Then, Fuse's perfect night's sleep is interrupted by an intruder: a very resilient and resourceful mouse! Who will triumph in this battle of wills? Finally, Slick and Newt go on a date, but things don't go as planned when Newt is infected by a werewolf!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures

Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering about animals on an ultimate adventure! Join Blippi and his robot friend FETCH as they travel the world to get their questions answered. How high can a kangaroo jump? Blippi finds out in a hopping race in Australia! How do bats see in the dark? A new bat friend shows him all about echolocation! The adventure continues as he learns why squirrels bury nuts and how ducks float. Blippi and FETCH also help their new friends, like when they work together to rebuild a blue jay's nest!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he and D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made and join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science and new friends!

programme.title: Antiks
